fighters.name: Zen
fighters.author: jev-arena
fighters.tagline: One sentence. No reflexes. How far does that go?
fighters.strategy: Win the fight. Do whatever a wise, calm fighter would do in this exact moment.

fighters.name: Glass Cannon
fighters.author: jev-arena
fighters.tagline: Every shot is a heavy shot.
fighters.strategy: Heavy shots win fights. Whenever I can see the enemy and my heavy shot is ready, I charge it. While it recharges I pepper the enemy with bolts. If the enemy rushes me, I back away and raise my shield. Battery power-ups are gold to me.

actions.charge: Fire whenever it is ready and the enemy is in sight, especially if it is standing still.

reflexes.when: The enemy is within 3 meters of me.
